semantics: Header resourceVersion/date/GFVersion; >=4 columns enables encryption and preserves seed verbatim. Newline split retains CR.
Rows with <4 columns ignored, exactly5 uses override version, >=6 uses manifest version. UInt64 size and Dictionary.Add exceptions retained.
Patch services append slash to root regardless existing slash or null; streaming services re-read path every lookup and do not add slash.
Successful records populate source fields and optional exact diagnostic log; missing warns then returns empty LocalPath record. Resolver emits second warning.
Streaming manifest assignment happens after construction so parser exception preserves previous manifest; empty input logs and installs empty manifest with null GFVersion.
Framework metadata defaults only for absent manifest; source Split and Trim behavior retained.
qualification: Native fixture uses synthetic patch text referencing rebuilt original UI bundle and explicit local directory. Does not prove original manifest location/config, server URLs, ResourceModule firstpack or complete account/menu startup.
